digest.component_or_area: code-review runtime seam for project criteria
propositions: Project-specific code-review criteria merge successfully in overlay but never execute, creating a silent failure indistinguishable from finding no issues.

The code-review runtime must activate project criteria through a stateless fan-in discriminator (PROJECT_FAN_IN_STEP_ID) reusing the plan-review pattern without adding DSL fields or hard-coded criterion ids.
Project prompt and eval assets must resolve from the reviewed repository snapshot, with missing or malformed assets raising a fatal LLMError before model execution.
Pass 3 decision logic must apply repository-effective routing (threshold, blocking posture, nit-suppression) using only logical criterion ids regardless of physical prompt output.

The CLI criterion_prompt_id and calibrate_criterion functions must accept a gate_key parameter to translate logical project ids to sanitized physical prompt ids for code-review, while preserving plan-review defaults.
